veranderings.voor: Hier is dit eers vrolik en word dit gespanne
veranderings.na: Hier is dit eers vrolik, en dan word dit gespanne
veranderings.rede: The verb-first second clause reads abruptly; 'eers ... dan' is the natural Afrikaans pairing, and the second clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS requires the comma before 'en' (differs from the rejected proposal: keeps 'dit', adds only 'dan' and the comma).

veranderings.voor: Lag gerus saam met 'n grappige oomblik, maar nie vir 'n kultuur nie
veranderings.na: Lag gerus saam wanneer iets snaaks gebeur, maar moenie vir 'n kultuur lag nie
veranderings.rede: One laughs along with people or at something funny, not 'saam met' a moment; this keeps the laugh-along versus laugh-at contrast and makes the second half a full clause, so the comma before 'maar' is correct.
